prompt: RimWorld creature sprite, side view, flat cel-shaded vanilla-RimWorld toy-figurine art style: the Pyrelands' ash-grazer -- a heavy-bodied grazer of the great post-burn herds, built to eat the regrowth sprint in the fertilized ash. style_notes: Re-render under the toy-figurine law. Reference is the donor Alpha Animals sprite for reskin-validate: keep the same footprint (broad grazer body, paired pincers), recolor to ash-grey/vivid-red and flatten to the toy-figurine convention.
